## Professional Summary
AI Engineer with 2+ years of production experience designing, building, and scaling end-to-end LLM and Generative AI systems on Azure and serverless infrastructure.
- Scaled multimodal AI systems to 4K–10K daily production requests with 99.9% uptime.
- Slashed inference cost by 80% (₹1.50 → ₹0.30/unit) and latency by 83% (60s → 10s) using prompt caching, smaller specialized models, and parallelized execution.
- Architected enterprise multi-tenant RAG systems with deterministic SHA-256 vector IDs, role-based metadata access control, Cohere Rerank, and Redis session memory achieving 90% Context Recall evaluated with Ragas.
- Engineered vision-LLM document extraction pipelines bypassing legacy OCR with 90% manual processing reduction.
- Built multi-agent systems using LangGraph, CrewAI, and supervisor coordinator patterns with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Generative AI & LLMs**: LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Prompt Caching, Multimodal AI (Gemini 2.0 Flash / 3.1 Pro / 3.1 Flash Lite, OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o mini, Groq Llama 3.3), Multi-Agent Systems, Conversational AI.
- **Retrieval & Vector Databases**: Pinecone, Supabase, pgvector, Dense Retrieval, Cohere Rerank, Semantic Search, Metadata Filtering.
- **Evaluation & Observability**: Ragas (Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Recall), LLM-as-a-Judge, Golden Dataset Testing (~200 scenarios), CI/CD Evaluation Gates, SigNoz Distributed Tracing, LangSmith.
- **Backend & Data**: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Redis (Session Memory, Caching), Server-Sent Events (SSE), Docker.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Azure (Function Apps, Serverless, VM, Web App), Google Cloud Platform (Vision API), CI/CD GitHub Actions, Docker, Linux.
